text: Money makes people rich; it is a fallacy to think it makes them better, or even that it makes them worse. People are what they do, and what they leave behind.
author: Terry Pratchett
visual_brief: An architectural section and elevation drawing in crisp white linework on black, showing a solid timber threshold. Dimension lines and fine dotted contours measure the smooth, shallow hollow worn into the grain by generations of passing footsteps.
alt: Architectural drawing of a wooden threshold worn down by footsteps
